description: This file contains functions for building and rendering execution and test plan trees in the TestLink project, including filtering, counters, and node processing logic.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plans, including retrieving skeletons and node types.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test projects, providing methods like getTestCasePrefix.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Class managing custom fields, with method get_by_id.

methods.name: execTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical execution tree for test cases with filtering and counters.

methods.name: testPlanTree
methods.description: Generates a visual tree of test plans, test suites, and test cases for display.

methods.name: initExecTree
methods.description: Initializes filters and options for tree construction based on user input.

methods.name: prepareExecTreeNode
methods.description: Aggregates counters and filters at each node, removing empty branches.

methods.name: applyStatusFilters
methods.description: Filters test items by execution status according to configuration.

methods.name: helperInitCounters
methods.description: Creates and initializes counters for test execution statuses.

methods.name: cfForDesign
methods.description: Filters custom fields applicable for design context.
